Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm delighted to hear that you'll be joining our team next week in the marketing department.

I'm really looking forward to working with you. If you have any questions before your first day or need help settling in, please don't hesitate to reach out to me.

Looking forward to meeting you soon!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
